title: Coverage Rental Billing of Hospital Beds & Support Surfaces
content:
## 1. Rule

Hospital Beds & Support Surfaces coverage rental months are billed on the anniversary of the rental period start date (the same day of each later month, with a month-end fallback; after a resumption, from the resumption date) under the class's billed code, months 1 to 3 at the class's rental fee for months 1 through 3 and later months at its rental fee from month 4 on, both of the billed class, plus the E0277 surface fees when a surface is furnished. The allowed amount is each fee multiplied by the coverage class's allowed percentage of the fee schedule and divided by 100, rounded to the cent half up, and then summed. Months are never prorated and no month beginning in a suspension is billed. A coverage rental month is billed only while the bed record is rental active.

## 2. Elements of the rule

1. **First day of each month.** Each month begins on the same day of the month as the rental period start date. Where a later month has no such day, the month begins on that month's last day. After a resumption, the anniversary is counted from the resumption date.
2. **Code and fee.** The month is billed under the class's billed code, and the fee read is that of the billed class: the months 1 through 3 fee for months numbered 1, 2 and 3, and the month 4 on fee for every later month.
3. **Surface.** When an E0277 surface is furnished, the surface's own fee for that month number is added as a separate fee.
4. **Allowed amount.** Each fee separately is multiplied by the coverage class's allowed percentage of the fee schedule, divided by 100 and rounded to the cent half up; the rounded amounts are then summed. Rounding happens once per fee, before the sum.
5. **Whole months only.** A month is never prorated.
6. **Suspension.** No month whose first day falls in a suspension is billed.
7. **Status.** A coverage rental month is billed only while the bed record is rental active; the bed record's status in the system is the evidence, read before the month is billed.

The fee figures are the class's published rental fees and E0277 surface fees; the allowed percentage belongs to the patient's coverage class in the Insurance Coverage & Patient Responsibility records.

## 3. Worked example (hypothetical inputs)

Hypothetical inputs: a Semi-Electric Hospital Bed (E0260) with an E0277 surface furnished; a coverage class allowing 96 percent of the fee schedule; the bed fee for months 1 through 3 is $148.64 and from month 4 on $111.48; the surface fee for months 1 through 3 is $520.00 and from month 4 on $390.00.

| Hypothetical month | Bed fee multiplied by 96 and divided by 100 | Rounded | Surface fee multiplied by 96 and divided by 100 | Rounded | Allowed amount (sum of the rounded parts) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Month 2 | 142.6944 | $142.69 | 499.20 | $499.20 | $641.89 |
| Month 5 | 107.0208 | $107.02 | 374.40 | $374.40 | $481.42 |

Without the surface, month 5 would be allowed at $107.02.

## 4. Month start dates (hypothetical rental period start dates)

| Hypothetical rental period start date | Following month starts |
|---|---|
| 14 January | 14 February, 14 March, 14 April |
| 31 January | last day of February, 31 March, 30 April |

## 5. Points of judgement

- **Billed code differs from the class.** Where a class's billed code is another class's code, the months are billed under that code and at that billed class's fees.
- **A month starting during a suspension.** It is not billed, whether the patient comes home a few days later or not.
- **Status not rental active.** A bed record in any other status has no coverage rental month billed.
